lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You didn’t cut corners. You didn’t buy answers. You kept your name clean even when the days got narrow.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It still wasn’t enough to hit the top line. The ranking broke against you by inches. No scandal—just a number.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The people who watched you work didn’t forget. A professor offered a smaller door; a supervisor wrote a recommendation with your real strengths underlined twice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You didn’t win the scholarship. You did, however, leave with something you won’t have to hide later: a reputation you can keep.
